composableDefault: Target public entry is available and its full contract is read.

componentDefault: Stop if a caller still depends on a prop/emission/type absent from target; do not add an alias, adapter or silent fallback.

rules: localPathCommand uses an escaped exact module token: nbook/app/components/common/(form/)?<Name>(.vue)? or components/common/(form/)?<Name>(.vue)?, bounded by quote/whitespace/end; Dialog never matches DialogWindow. It excludes the named local SFC itself and scans app, plugins and related test source/path evidence.

templateBindingCheck parses each non-generated Vue SFC with @vue/compiler-sfc and its extracted script with TypeScript AST; every matching PascalCase/kebab-case tag must be bound in that same SFC by a named ImportDeclaration from @notnotype/nb-ui/components for the exact target name. It never joins separate imports, so a local Name plus unrelated target import fails.
A bare <Name> or <kebab-name> tag is not a local-reference proof and cannot satisfy the old-surface deletion gate.
No unprefixed nb-ui Nuxt module, alias, adapter or implicit auto-registration is accepted.

expectations.localPathZero: localPathCommand returns exit 1 with no exact-module matches; DialogWindow is not a Dialog match; scanner excludes the named local SFC itself but retains test source/path assertions.
expectations.templateBindingInvariant: templateBindingCheck returns exit 0 only when every non-local .vue SFC containing PascalCase/kebab-case tag has an exact named target import in the same SFC AST; bare tags, local import plus unrelated target import, and DialogWindow-only imports fail for Dialog.
expectations.scope: Current app plus related tests/config; generated/build/old worktrees are excluded.
expectations.targetImport: @notnotype/nb-ui/components; explicit same-name import or an explicitly recorded resolved binding is required.

rules: Scan current app, packages/neuro-book/plugins/** and related test files; optional NBOOK_SYMBOL_GATE_ROOT is a system-temp fixture root for smoke tests; exclude generated/build/old-worktree paths and the local definition file.
Local gate continues to track old module path/import/source/negative/mock evidence and excludes only the local definition file from executable caller scan.
Target gate uses semanticClassifier AST identifier usage, not whole-file substring matching; strings, negative/source assertions, mock keys, property names and member properties are excluded.
Target identifier need not be zero; each semantic usage must be bound by an explicit named import from targetModule. Local gate still tracks old module path/import/source/mock/negative evidence.
api-error deletion is a named-export gate for message, code and status, not a whole-module path zero check.

expectations.localPathZero: exit 1 post-cutover: no local module+named-symbol import/path/source/negative/mock evidence outside local definition file.
expectations.targetBinding: exit 0 post-cutover: every semantic targetName Identifier reference must resolve through the same-file ImportSpecifier whose importedName is targetName and whose moduleSpecifier is targetModule; collect importedName → localAlias → moduleSpecifier, so used wrong-module aliases, parameter/local shadow references, and undeclared bare names are targetBad, while unused wrong-module imports and strings/source/negative assertions/mock keys/property names/member properties are ignored; zero semantic usage allowed.
expectations.verifier: independent scope-aware AST/TypeChecker verifier reports localBad=[] and targetBad=[] post-migration; current local imports, wrong-module aliases, shadow references and unbound semantic target usages are expected failures; ignored non-usage categories remain excluded.
expectations.fileDeletion: api-error delete only after named message, code and status exports have no local import/path/source evidence; retaining code/status while message migrates is valid.

usageRules: Count executable/type Identifier references by TypeScript checker binding; each reference must resolve to a same-file ImportSpecifier for importedName targetName from targetModule.

Exclude ImportSpecifier/ImportClause declarations, string/template literals, object/property keys (including vi.mock factory export keys), member property names when non-computed, labels, and negative/source assertion literals.
Count shorthand properties only when the checker resolves the identifier as the imported value binding; a mock key useNotification: function key is excluded.
Local gate separately retains module path/import/source/negative/mock evidence; target gate checks only semantic usage against explicit named target import.
A used localAlias imported from any module other than targetModule is wrong-module target usage and fails targetBinding; an unused wrong-module alias is not a usage and does not block.

Collect every named import as importedName → localAlias → moduleSpecifier. Used wrong-module aliases, parameter/local shadow references, and undeclared bare original names are targetBad; unused wrong-module aliases do not block.

semanticClassifier.implementation: Executable target/verifier commands use a TypeScript Program and TypeChecker over an in-memory single source file; Vue script/script setup are extracted with @vue/compiler-sfc parse/compileScript. Component templateBinding uses @vue/compiler-sfc template AST plus TypeScript ImportDeclaration binding in the same SFC. Every candidate reference must resolve to the same-file ImportSpecifier with importedName targetName and moduleSpecifier targetModule; aliases are resolved by local binding. Import/export/declaration identifiers, strings/templates, object/property keys including vi.mock keys, non-computed member properties, labels, and source/negative assertion text are excluded. Wrong-module aliases, shadowed parameter/local references, and undeclared bare names fail; unused wrong-module aliases pass.
